propositions: rebar config validate bypasses typed coercion and enum validation by calling only scan_tombstones on raw TOML, allowing invalid enum values like reconciler.rich_text_cutover="clould" to pass as valid
rebar config validate exits 0 and reports "OK — no removed inputs are set" even when live typed keys contain invalid values that would be rejected by rebar config
reconciler.rich_text_cutover enum constraint is enforced only in the canonical load_config path, which config validate deliberately circumvents
config validate should aggregate both tombstone diagnostics and typed-value validation errors in a single invocation without early exit on first error
store mounting before validation causes early exit on TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR issues, preventing aggregation of all configuration errors
